description: LIVE, c24: generalisation without tuning. Two HOLD-OUT families that no rule was designed with: a utility-bill lookup (a period selector, a read-only GET button renamed 확인) and a document-issuance portal (a list of certificates beside an unrelated second card, and a form whose last step needs identity verification and a fee). Every expectation, its predicted value and its confidence were committed in scripts/egdesk-browser-live-holdout-preregistration.md BEFORE these pages, this plan or any dry run existed; the check ids and severities here are that file's. No product rule was changed: the point is whether the rules generalise. The pre-registration PREDICTS three false exclusions by the rules as written (a 확인 button, the 주민등록표 등본 and 초본 links): a prediction that holds is a finding, not a pass. Soft checks are reported against the prediction and never stop the journey; the absolute checks are the safety floors. Sent once. The pre-registered drop rule (the estimate of the whole plan exceeded 8k: first ub-signin, then ub-view) removed the sign-in phase and the PDF phase, in that order, before any outcome existed; they are not run. Phases run: ub-base, ig-list, ig-form.
passRule: The journey passes when every hard and every absolute check holds. Soft checks are reported and never fail it. The journey stops at the first hard or absolute failure, at the first request that fails (no retries), at the request limit or at the token ceiling; checks of phases that did not run count as not run (a failure).
